title: a figure for loss-decomp's stages.tbl
body: stages.tbl is one row per (unit, run) with a column per checkpoint: never seeded, seeded but absent from the table, scored below the family's cutoff, kept. Nothing draws it. A first attempt scattered wall clock against sensitivity and was rejected: this benchmark shows where in nail's pipeline the hits were lost, and a point per arm gives the total without saying which stage took it.

notes.author: jackroddy/01dd6c44
notes.text: Real results, twelve arms over two corpora, 130 minutes, 103 steps, 0 failed. Five of the twelve (seed / align / cutoff / sens): MGnify 472,845 truth: static-ms200 169,510 / 7 / 7,987 / 0.6246; static-ms2000 30,688 / 27 / 23,366 / 0.8856; static-ms20000 16,713 / 33 / 25,689 / 0.9103; prog-n800-f.001 17,257 / 32 / 25,615 / 0.9093; prog-n50-f0.1 25,949 / 23 / 23,725 / 0.8949. Swissprot 1,001,825 truth: 514,136 / 10 / 11,200 / 0.4756; 92,645 / 80 / 44,867 / 0.8627; 45,314 / 100 / 53,493 / 0.9013; 45,046 / 107 / 53,675 / 0.9014; 59,735 / 76 / 49,055 / 0.8913. The cutoff loss grows as the seeding opens up and ends up the larger of the two in 9 of MGnify's 12 arms and 7 of Swissprot's. lost_align is 7 to 107 in every arm, so cloud search and alignment lose nothing worth drawing. The corpora differ most where seeding is tightest: 14.9 points at ms200, 0.9 by ms20000.
